On Nov 3, George had 22 points and 5 assists in 37 minutes in a 103-94 win over this same Orlando team. I found no current injury report for him or for either team ahead of this game.

Rotowire lists Cunningham as probable for Sunday in Atlanta and says he plans to play through minor right-knee soreness. He averages 25.6 points and 5.1 rebounds, about 30.7 combined, just below 31.5, and has shot 25.6% from three over his last seven games.
The preview says Cunningham averages 25.8 points in 13 career games against Atlanta. He returned Friday from a one-game knee absence and led the team with 23 points in the loss to Toronto.

The odds page lists Cunningham's points prop at 26.5 across books (Fanatics over -105, bet365 under -110). That leaves roughly 5 rebounds of the 31.5 combined line, about his season rebounding average.
